name: Hand Axe
description: A compact axe with a sturdy haft and razor-sharp edge for brutal close combat.

name: Dagger
description: A short, double-edged blade useful for defense, duels, or daily survival tasks.

name: Large Shield
description: A heavy shield reinforced with iron, its surface scarred by blades and arrows alike.

name: Cavalry Hammer
description: A hammer designed for mounted knights, its blunt head able to crush armor while a spike pierces through helmets.

name: Cavalry Lance
description: A long wooden lance designed to deliver devastating charges that pierce armor and scatter enemy lines.

name: Rapier
description: A slender dueling sword, its blade perfect for thrusts, flourishes, and lethal precision strikes.

name: Knuckledusters
description: Simple but brutal iron rings fitted to the fist, favored by tavern brawlers and thieves for close and vicious fighting.

name: Grain Flail
description: A converted farming tool turned into a weapon, its chain and wooden staff capable of striking with surprising force.

name: Military Flail
description: A weaponized flail with spiked heads, crafted for war, capable of smashing shields and breaking enemy lines.

name: Main Gauche
description: A parrying dagger with an extended guard, commonly used alongside a rapier to deflect and counter strikes in duels.

name: Swordbreaker
description: A dagger with deep notches designed to catch and snap enemy blades, favored by duelists and rogues.

name: Halberd
description: A polearm combining axe blade, spear tip, and hook to deal with armored enemies and cavalry alike.

name: Spear
description: A versatile weapon with a pointed steel head, effective in ranks or thrown at short range.

name: Quarterstaff
description: A simple wooden staff used for training and self-defense, effective in skilled hands at keeping foes at bay.

name: Bastard Sword
description: A versatile longsword wielded with one or two hands, valued for its balance between power and control.

name: Great Axe
description: A massive, brutal two-handed axe warped by dark runes, carried by warriors who revel in destruction on the battlefield.

name: Warhammer
description: A two-handed hammer bearing engravings and designed to crush armor and skulls with righteous fury.

name: Zweihander
description: A massive two-handed sword capable of sweeping blows that can cleave through multiple foes.

name: Long Rifle
description: A prized firearm with intricate mechanisms and deadly accuracy across battlefield distances.

name: Handgun
description: A blackpowder firearm firing deadly lead shot capable of piercing armor, though slow to reload.

name: Pistol
description: A compact blackpowder firearm, deadly at close range but often unreliable.

name: War Bow
description: An elegant, finely crafted bow of gleaming wood, its draw smooth and precise, with deadly accuracy from great distances.

name: Longbow
description: A tall yew longbow renowned for its range and accuracy, used in hunting and on the battlefield against armored foes.

name: Shortbow
description: A simple shortbow, easy to draw and fire quickly, often carried by scouts, hunters, and militias for skirmishing.

name: Crossbow Pistol
description: An ingenious contraption, this compact crossbow pistol allows concealed yet deadly shots, favored by assassins and mercenaries alike.

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: A powerful two-handed crossbow capable of piercing armor, slow to reload but devastating in the hands of trained marksmen.

name: Repeater Handgun
description: A rare and ingenious firearm that can fire multiple shots before reloading, valued highly by wealthy officers and noble hunters.

name: Whip
description: A flexible leather lash used by beastmasters and guards, capable of striking at range or controlling unruly foes.

name: Bomb
description: A dangerous blackpowder device, crudely crafted but capable of wreaking havoc with fire, smoke, and deadly shrapnel.

name: Sling
description: A simple leather sling hurling stones with surprising force against lightly armored foes.

name: Staff Sling
description: A two-handed sling mounted on a staff, capable of launching stones farther and harder than a simple hand sling.

name: Bolas
description: A throwing weapon of weighted cords, designed to entangle legs and bring down prey or fleeing enemies with precision.

name: Throwing Dart
description: Small and easily concealed, these darts can be hurled quickly and silently, favored by rogues and assassins.

name: Javelin
description: A light spear designed for throwing, carried by skirmishers and hunters, effective at harassing enemy ranks.

name: Throwing Axe
description: A balanced axe designed to be hurled with deadly accuracy, often used in raids and ambushes.

name: Throwing Knife
description: A set of balanced knives designed for throwing, often hidden beneath cloaks and favored by rogues and hired killers.
